AbolishPipelineRun.title: Stop a deployment process
AbolishPipelineRun.summary: Calls this operation to change the status of a specified deployment process to terminated. The deployment process is not deleted and can still be queried through query operations.

AddEntityIntoMetaCollection.title: Add an entity object to a data map collection
AddEntityIntoMetaCollection.summary: Adds a specified entity object to a Data Map collection. The collection object can be a Data Map category or a data album. The entity object currently supports only the data table type. To add an entity to a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission, or be the creator or administrator of the album.

ApplyResourceAccessPermission.title: Submit a Resource Access Permission Application
ApplyResourceAccessPermission.summary: Submits an application for access permissions on a specific resource.

ApproveProcessInstance.title: Approve a workflow instance
ApproveProcessInstance.summary: Approves or rejects a specified approval process instance.

AssociateProjectToImage.title: AssociateProjectToImage
AssociateProjectToImage.summary: Associates an image with a workspace.

AssociateProjectToResourceGroup.title: AssociateProjectToResourceGroup
AssociateProjectToResourceGroup.summary: Associates a resource group with a workspace.

AttachDataQualityRulesToEvaluationTask.title: Associate data quality rules with quality monitoring
AttachDataQualityRulesToEvaluationTask.summary: Associates data quality rules with a data quality check task.

BatchCreateMetaEntities.title: Batch create metadata entities
BatchCreateMetaEntities.summary: Creates metadata entities in batches. All entities in the same batch must be of the same type. Currently, only custom entity types and extension table types (corresponding to Database/Table) are supported.

BatchDeleteMetaEntities.title: Batch delete metadata entities
BatchDeleteMetaEntities.summary: Deletes metadata entity objects in batches. Supports deleting custom entities and extension table type objects (Database/Table). Does not support deleting columns individually. You can delete associated Column objects by deleting the Table.

BatchUpdateTasks.title: Batch update nodes
BatchUpdateTasks.summary: Updates multiple nodes in batches by using incremental updates.

CancelAgentSession.title: Cancel a session
CancelAgentSession.summary: Interrupts the Agent call for a specified session, supporting interruption during streaming responses.

CloneDataSource.title: Clone a data source
CloneDataSource.summary: Clones a new data source based on an existing data source.

CreateAgentSession.title: Create a session
CreateAgentSession.summary: Creates a new agent session and returns the session ID.

CreateAlertRule.title: Create a custom monitoring alert rule
CreateAlertRule.summary: Creates a custom monitoring alert rule.

CreateBusiness.title: Create a business process
CreateBusiness.summary: Creates a business process in DataStudio for data development.

CreateComputeResource.title: Create a compute resource
CreateComputeResource.summary: Creates a compute resource in a specified workspace. The compute resource can be in the development environment or production environment.

CreateCrawler.title: Create a metadata crawler
CreateCrawler.summary: Creates a metadata crawler and configures the data source, collection scope, resource group, and scheduling method.

CreateDIAlarmRule.title: Create an alert rule for a data integration synchronization task
CreateDIAlarmRule.summary: Creates an alert rule for a data integration task.

CreateDIJob.title: Create a data integration synchronization task

CreateDataQualityAlertRule.title: Create a data quality alert rule
CreateDataQualityAlertRule.summary: Creates a data quality monitoring alert rule in a specified project.

CreateDataQualityEvaluationTask.title: Create a data quality monitor
CreateDataQualityEvaluationTask.summary: Creates a DataWorks data quality monitor.

CreateDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.title: Create a data quality check monitoring instance
CreateDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.summary: Creates a data quality check task instance.

CreateDataQualityScanRun.title: Create a data quality scan run
CreateDataQualityScanRun.summary: Triggers the execution of a specified data quality monitoring task and returns the run instance ID.

CreateDataSource.title: Create a data source
CreateDataSource.summary: Creates a data source in a specified project workspace for the development or production environment.

CreateDataSourceSharedRule.title: CreateDataSourceSharedRule
CreateDataSourceSharedRule.summary: Creates a sharing rule for a data source to share it with other workspaces or RAM users.

CreateDataset.title: Create a dataset
CreateDataset.summary: Creates a dataset. You can create a dataset only in a workspace that you have joined. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The maximum number of datasets per tenant is 2000.

CreateDatasetVersion.title: Create a dataset version
CreateDatasetVersion.summary: Creates a dataset version. Currently, only DataWorks datasets are supported. The maximum number of versions is 20.

CreateFile.title: Create a file in dataStudio
CreateFile.summary: Creates a file in DataStudio. This operation does not support creating Data Integration nodes.

CreateFunction.title: Create a dataStudio function
CreateFunction.summary: Creates a UDF function in DataStudio. The UDF function information is described in FlowSpec format.

CreateLineageRelationship.title: Register data lineage relationship in data map
CreateLineageRelationship.summary: Registers a data lineage relationship in DataWorks Data Map. You can use this operation to establish lineage relationships between metadata entities managed by DataWorks, including table-to-table, column-to-column, table-to-column, and dataset-to-table scenarios. You can also establish lineage relationships between managed entities and custom entity objects registered by users. This operation is compatible with non-managed custom objects, but this approach is no longer recommended. Before calling this operation, make sure that the managed entities involved in the lineage registration already exist on the DataWorks platform.

CreateMetaCollection.title: CreateMetaCollection
CreateMetaCollection.summary: Creates a collection in Data Map. Collections include categories, subcategories, data albums, and categories that are created in the data albums.

CreateMetaEntityDef.title: Create a metadata entity type definition
CreateMetaEntityDef.summary: Creates a metadata entity definition, including custom types and extended table types.

CreateNetwork.title: CreateNetwork
CreateNetwork.summary: Creates a network and associates the network with a general resource group.

CreateNode.title: Create a data development node
CreateNode.summary: Creates a data development node in the new version of DataStudio.

CreatePipelineRun.title: Create a publish process
CreatePipelineRun.summary: Creates a publish process for an entity in the new-version DataStudio.

CreateProcessDefinition.title: CreateApprovalProcessDefinition
CreateProcessDefinition.summary: Creates a new approval process definition, supporting custom configuration of approval rules and notification services.

CreateProjectMember.title: Create a workspace member
CreateProjectMember.summary: Adds a workspace member and grants workspace roles to the member.

CreateProjectRole.title: CreateProjectRole
CreateProjectRole.summary: Creates a custom role for a workspace.

CreateResource.title: Create a data development file resource
CreateResource.summary: Creates a file resource for data development. The file resource information is defined in FlowSpec format.

CreateResourceFile.title: Create Resource File
CreateResourceFile.summary: Supports users in specifying their own files (such as JAR, PY, archive, or file) to create Data Development resource files.

CreateRoute.title: CreateRoute
CreateRoute.summary: Creates a route for a network.

CreateSecurityStrategy.title: CreateSecurityStrategy
CreateSecurityStrategy.summary: Creates a new security control policy to configure various modules and submodules. Requires both DataWorks tenant administrator and security administrator permissions.

CreateSemanticJob.title: Create a semantic job
CreateSemanticJob.summary: Saves a reusable semantic job definition. If you use a single-file source, apply for and complete the attachment upload first. After creation, call RunSemanticJob with the returned Name.

CreateSkill.title: Create a skill
CreateSkill.summary: Creates a new Skill in DataWorks.

CreateUdfFile.title: CreateUdfFile
CreateUdfFile.summary: Creates a file for a function in DataStudio.

CreateWorkflowDefinition.title: Create a dataStudio workflow
CreateWorkflowDefinition.summary: Creates a workflow in a specified folder in DataStudio.

CreateWorkflowInstances.title: Create a workflow instance
CreateWorkflowInstances.summary: Creates a workflow instance based on configurations, such as a data backfill workflow instance.

DeleteAlertRule.title: Delete a custom rule
DeleteAlertRule.summary: Deletes a custom monitoring alert rule.

DeleteComputeResource.title: DeleteComputeResource
DeleteComputeResource.summary: Deletes the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID.

DeleteDIAlarmRule.title: DeleteDIAlarmRule
DeleteDIAlarmRule.summary: Deletes an alert rule configured for a synchronization task.

DeleteDataQualityAlertRule.title: Delete a data quality alert rule
DeleteDataQualityAlertRule.summary: Deletes a data quality monitoring alert rule based on the specified ID.

DeleteDataQualityEvaluationTask.title: Delete a data quality monitor
DeleteDataQualityEvaluationTask.summary: Deletes a data quality monitoring task.

DeleteDataQualityRule.title: DeleteDataQualityRule
DeleteDataQualityRule.summary: Deletes a data quality monitoring rule.

DeleteDataQualityRuleTemplate.title: Delete a custom data quality rule template
DeleteDataQualityRuleTemplate.summary: Deletes a custom data quality rule template.

DeleteDataQualityTemplate.title: DeleteDataQualityTemplate
DeleteDataQualityTemplate.summary: Deletes a data quality rule template by ID.

DeleteDataSource.title: DeleteDataSource
DeleteDataSource.summary: Deletes a data source by data source ID.

DeleteDataSourceSharedRule.title: DeleteDataSourceSharedRule
DeleteDataSourceSharedRule.summary: Deletes a data source sharing rule by rule ID.

DeleteDataset.title: Delete a dataset
DeleteDataset.summary: Deletes a dataset. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The corresponding dataset versions are cascade deleted. The operator must be the creator of the dataset or an administrator of the workspace to which the dataset belongs.

DeleteDatasetVersion.title: DeleteDatasetVersion
DeleteDatasetVersion.summary: Deletes a dataset version. Only non-v1 DataWorks datasets are supported. To delete v1 datasets, use the DeleteDataset operation. Requires dataset creator or workspace administrator permissions.

DeleteFile.title: DeleteFile
DeleteFile.summary: Deletes a file from DataStudio. If the file has been committed, an asynchronous process is triggered to delete the file in the scheduling system. The value of the DeploymentId parameter returned is used to call the GetDeployment operation to poll the status of the asynchronous process.

DeleteFolder.title: DeleteFolder
DeleteFolder.summary: Invoke DeleteFolder to delete a folder on the Data Development page.

DeleteFunction.title: DeleteFunction
DeleteFunction.summary: Deletes a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio.

DeleteLineageRelationship.title: Delete a data lineage relationship
DeleteLineageRelationship.summary: Deletes a specified data lineage relationship from DataWorks Data Map.

DeleteMetaCollection.title: Delete a Data Map collection object
DeleteMetaCollection.summary:
Delete a collection object in the specified Data Map, including Data Map categories and data albums.
When deleting a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission or be the creator or administrator of the album.

DeleteMetaEntityDef.title: Delete a metadata entity definition
DeleteMetaEntityDef.summary: Deletes a metadata entity definition, including custom entity types and extension table types.

DeleteNetwork.title: Disassociate and delete a network resource from a general-purpose resource group
DeleteNetwork.summary: Disassociates and deletes a network resource from a general-purpose resource group.

DeleteProcessDefinition.title: DeleteProcessDefinition
DeleteProcessDefinition.summary: Deletes a process definition by the specified ID.

DeleteProjectMember.title: Remove a workspace member
DeleteProjectMember.summary: Removes a workspace member and the workspace roles granted to the member.

DeleteProjectRole.title: DeleteProjectRole
DeleteProjectRole.summary: Deletes a custom role from a workspace.

DeleteResource.title: DeleteResource
DeleteResource.summary: Deletes a file resource from DataStudio.

DeleteRoute.title: DeleteRoute
DeleteRoute.summary: Deletes a route from a network resource.

DeleteSecurityStrategy.title: DeleteSecurityStrategy
DeleteSecurityStrategy.summary: Deletes a security strategy by its ID. To call this operation, you must have DataWorks tenant administrator and security administrator permissions.

DeleteSemanticJob.title: Delete a semantic job
DeleteSemanticJob.summary: Deletes a semantic job definition by the Name of a created job. If the job is currently running, call KillSemanticJob with the ExecutorJobId of that run and confirm the stop before deletion.

DeleteWorkflowDefinition.title: Delete a data development workflow
DeleteWorkflowDefinition.summary: Deletes a specified workflow in data development.

DeployFile.title: Deploy file
DeployFile.summary: Deploys a file to the production environment.

DetachDataQualityRulesFromEvaluationTask.title: Remove the association between a data quality rule and a monitoring task
DetachDataQualityRulesFromEvaluationTask.summary: Removes the association between a data quality rule and a data quality monitoring task.

DisableProcessDefinition.title: DisableProcessDefinition
DisableProcessDefinition.summary: Disables the specified approval process definition.

DissociateProjectFromImage.title: DissociateProjectFromImage
DissociateProjectFromImage.summary: Disassociates an image from a workspace.

DissociateProjectFromResourceGroup.title: Disassociate a resource group from a workspace
DissociateProjectFromResourceGroup.summary: Disassociates a resource group from a workspace.

DownloadSemanticResults.title: Get semantic job result download URL
DownloadSemanticResults.summary: Returns the download URL of artifacts by job name and an optional run ID after a run completes. If JobRunId is not specified, the results of the most recent run of the job are returned.

EnableProcessDefinition.title: EnableProcessDefinition
EnableProcessDefinition.summary: Enables a process definition with the specified ID.

EstablishRelationTableToBusiness.title: EstablishRelationTableToBusiness
EstablishRelationTableToBusiness.summary: Imports a table to a workflow. The call to this API operation is equivalent to performing the following operations: Go to the DataStudio page, find the desired workflow, and then click the workflow name. Right-click Table under the desired folder and select Import Table.

ExecPipelineRunStage.title: Execute a specified stage of a publish flow
ExecPipelineRunStage.summary: Executes a specified stage of a publish flow.

ExecuteAdhocWorkflowInstance.title: Run a temporary workflow instance
ExecuteAdhocWorkflowInstance.summary: Creates a temporary workflow instance based on the specified configuration.

FindBestMatchSecurityStrategy.title: Match Best Security Policy
FindBestMatchSecurityStrategy.summary: Find the security policy that best matches the given conditions.

GetAgentSessionArtifactMeta.title: GetAgentSessionArtifactMeta
GetAgentSessionArtifactMeta.summary: Retrieves the metadata and content of an artifact based on a session ID and artifact path.

GetAgentSessionTokenUsage.title: GetAgentSessionTokenUsage
GetAgentSessionTokenUsage.summary: Retrieves the cumulative AI token usage for a specified session.

GetAlertRule.title: Retrieve a custom monitoring alert rule
GetAlertRule.summary: Retrieves a custom monitoring alert rule.

GetApplicationContents.title: Get Resource Permission Application Details
GetApplicationContents.summary: Queries the content of resource permission applications under the specified process instance ID.

GetBusiness.title: Query business process details
GetBusiness.summary: Queries the details of a business process by calling GetBusiness.

GetCatalog.title: Get data catalog details in data map
GetCatalog.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified data catalog in DataWorks Data Map. Currently, DLF and StarRocks catalog types are supported.

GetColumn.title: Get data map table column information
GetColumn.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified column in a Data Map table.

GetComputeResource.title: GetComputeResource
GetComputeResource.summary: Queries the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID.

GetCrawler.title: Query metadata crawler details
GetCrawler.summary: Queries the configuration, status, and latest run information of a specified metadata crawler.

GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities.title: Query crawler type capabilities
GetCrawlerTypeCapabilities.summary: Queries the crawler types supported in the current region, along with their collection scope, scheduling, and extension configuration capabilities.

GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult.title: GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult
GetCreateWorkflowInstancesResult.summary: Queries the result of asynchronously creating a workflow instance.

GetDIJobLog.title: View the run logs of a data integration synchronization task
GetDIJobLog.summary: Retrieves the task logs of a data integration node.

GetDataQualityAlertRule.title: GetDataQualityAlertRule
GetDataQualityAlertRule.summary: Retrieves the details of a data quality alert rule by rule ID.

GetDataQualityEvaluationTask.title: Query data quality monitoring details
GetDataQualityEvaluationTask.summary: Query the details of a data quality validation task.

GetDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.title: Retrieve data quality check task instance details.
GetDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstance.summary: Retrieves the details of a data quality check task instance.

GetDataQualityRule.title: Queries the details of a data quality rule
GetDataQualityRule.summary: Queries the details of a data quality rule.

GetDataQualityRuleTemplate.title: Queries the details of a data quality rule template
GetDataQualityRuleTemplate.summary: Queries the details of a data quality rule template.

GetDataQualityScanRun.title: GetDataQualityScanRun
GetDataQualityScanRun.summary: Creates a data quality monitoring run instance.

GetDataQualityScanRunLog.title: GetDataQualityScanRunLog
GetDataQualityScanRunLog.summary: Queries the log of a specific task instance that monitors data quality.

GetDataQualityTemplate.title: GetDataQualityTemplate
GetDataQualityTemplate.summary: Retrieves the details of a data quality rule template by template ID.

GetDataSource.title: View data source details
GetDataSource.summary: Queries a specified data source by data source ID.

GetDatabase.title: GetDatabase
GetDatabase.summary: Queries the information about a specific database in Data Map.

GetDataset.title: GetDataset
GetDataset.summary: Gets the details of a dataset.

GetDatasetVersion.title: GetDatasetVersion
GetDatasetVersion.summary: Gets information for a given dataset version.

GetDeploymentPackage.title: Retrieve deployment package details
GetDeploymentPackage.summary: Retrieves the details of a deployment package.

GetFile.title: Obtain the details of a file
GetFile.summary: Retrieves the details of a file.

GetFileVersion.title: Get file version details
GetFileVersion.summary: Retrieves the version details of a file.

GetFolder.title: GetFolder
GetFolder.summary: Queries the information about a folder.

GetFunction.title: GetFunction
GetFunction.summary: Queries the information about a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio.

GetIDEEventDetail.title: GetIDEEventDetail
GetIDEEventDetail.summary: Queries the data snapshot of an extension point based on the ID of a message in DataWorks OpenEvent when the related extension point event is triggered.

GetImage.title: Retrieve image details by ID
GetImage.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified image by image ID.

GetJobStatus.title: Get asynchronous API running status
GetJobStatus.summary: Returns the status of an asynchronous task. After calling an asynchronous API, poll this API to obtain the success status.

GetLineageRelationship.title: Get data lineage relationship details
GetLineageRelationship.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified lineage relationship in DataWorks Data Map.

GetMcpServer.title: GetMcpServer
GetMcpServer.summary: Returns the details of an MCP Server.

GetMetaCollection.title: GetMetaCollection
GetMetaCollection.summary: Queries the information about a collection in Data Map. Collections include categories and data albums.

GetMetaEntity.title: GetMetaEntity
GetMetaEntity.summary: Retrieves the details of a custom entity.

GetMetaEntityDef.title: GetMetaEntityDef
GetMetaEntityDef.summary: Retrieves the details of a custom entity definition.

GetNetwork.title: GetNetwork
GetNetwork.summary: Queries the information about a network resource.

GetNode.title: GetNode
GetNode.summary: Queries the information about a node in DataStudio.

GetParameter.title: GetParameter
GetParameter.summary: Gets the details of a parameter by its ID.

GetPartition.title: GetPartition
GetPartition.summary: Retrieves partition details for a data map table. Currently supports MaxCompute and HMS (EMR cluster) types only.

GetPipelineRun.title: Retrieve deployment process details
GetPipelineRun.summary: Retrieves the details of a deployment process.

GetProcessDefinition.title: GetProcessDefinition
GetProcessDefinition.summary: Retrieves the approval policy for a given process definition ID.

GetProcessInstance.title: GetProcessInstance
GetProcessInstance.summary: Retrieves details for a specified approval process instance, including its approval nodes and task list.

GetProject.title: Get workspace details
GetProject.summary: Queries the details of a DataWorks workspace.

GetProjectMember.title: GetProjectMember
GetProjectMember.summary: Retrieves the details of a specific member in a Workspace.

GetProjectRole.title: GetProjectRole
GetProjectRole.summary: Queries the details of a workspace role.

GetRerunWorkflowInstancesResult.title: Obtain the result of a rerun workflow instance
GetRerunWorkflowInstancesResult.summary: Query the result of an asynchronous rerun workflow instance

GetResource.title: GetResource
GetResource.summary: Queries the information about a file resource.

GetResourceGroup.title: Get resource group information by ID
GetResourceGroup.summary: Retrieves the information of a specified resource group by ID.

GetRoute.title: GetRoute
GetRoute.summary: Queries the information about a route based on its ID.

GetSchema.title: GetSchema
GetSchema.summary: Retrieves the schema details of a specified table in Data Map. Only MaxCompute and Hologres schemas are supported.

GetSecurityStrategy.title: GetSecurityStrategy
GetSecurityStrategy.summary: Retrieves the details of a security policy by its ID. This operation requires both DataWorks tenant administrator and security administrator permissions.

GetSemanticJobDetail.title: Query semantic job run details
GetSemanticJobDetail.summary: Queries the executor status and runtime configuration by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns.

GetSemanticJobLog.title: Query semantic job run logs
GetSemanticJobLog.summary: Queries execution logs by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns. The current POP contract exposes only the task and workspace identifiers and returns default log segments.

GetSkill.title: GetSkill
GetSkill.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified Skill by name, including the body of the SKILL.md file and the bundle's download link.

GetSnapshot.title: Retrieve version snapshot details
GetSnapshot.summary: Retrieves the details of a version snapshot.

GetTable.title: Retrieve data map table details
GetTable.summary: Retrieves the details of a specified table in Data Map. You can choose whether to return business metadata.

GetTask.title: GetTask
GetTask.summary: Queries the information about a task.

GetTaskInstance.title: GetTaskInstance
GetTaskInstance.summary: Queries the information about an instance.

GetTaskInstanceLog.title: GetTaskInstanceLog
GetTaskInstanceLog.summary: Queries the run log generated during a specific run of an instance.

GetWorkflow.title: GetWorkflow
GetWorkflow.summary: Queries the information about a workflow.

GetWorkflowDefinition.title: GetWorkflowDefinition
GetWorkflowDefinition.summary: Queries the information about a workflow.

GetWorkflowInstance.title: GetWorkflowInstance
GetWorkflowInstance.summary: Queries the information about a workflow instance.

GrantMemberProjectRoles.title: GrantMemberProjectRoles
GrantMemberProjectRoles.summary: Assigns roles to members in a workspace.

ImportWorkflowDefinition.title: Import a dataStudio workflow
ImportWorkflowDefinition.summary: Imports a workflow node defined by FlowSpec and its internal child nodes into DataStudio.

KillSemanticJob.title: Stop a semantic job run
KillSemanticJob.summary: Stops a specified run by using the ExecutorJobId returned by RunSemanticJob or ListSemanticJobRuns. A successful call indicates only that the stop request has been accepted. Query the final status by calling GetSemanticJobDetail.

ListAgentSessionArtifacts.title: Query session artifact list
ListAgentSessionArtifacts.summary: Queries the list of artifact files produced by a specified session.

ListAgentSessions.title: ListAgentSessions
ListAgentSessions.summary: Retrieves the conversation history for the agent session.

ListAgents.title: Query agent list
ListAgents.summary: Queries the list of agents available to the current tenant, with support for filtering by name and pagination.

ListAlertRules.title: ListAlertRules
ListAlertRules.summary: Queries a list of custom monitoring alert rules.

ListCatalogs.title: ListCatalogs
ListCatalogs.summary: Queries a list of catalogs in Data Map. Only catalogs of the Data Lake Formation (DLF) and StarRocks metadata crawler types are supported. For the DLF metadata crawler type, all supported data catalogs are returned. For the StarRocks metadata crawler type, data catalogs in a specific instance are returned.

ListCertificates.title: ListCertificates
ListCertificates.summary: Retrieves a list of certificate files.

ListColumns.title: Query columns of a data map table
ListColumns.summary: Queries the column list of a specified table in DataWorks Data Map.

ListComputeResources.title: ListComputeResources
ListComputeResources.summary: Queries the list of computing resources that meet the specified business information.

ListCrawlerRuns.title: Query crawler run records
ListCrawlerRuns.summary: Queries the run records of a specified metadata crawler by paging, with optional filtering by time range and run status.

ListCrawlerTypes.title: ListCrawlerTypes
ListCrawlerTypes.summary: Queries a list of metadata crawler types supported in Data Map. The subtypes of the types and the hierarchical relationship between the subtypes are also returned.

ListCrawlers.title: List metadata crawlers
ListCrawlers.summary: Queries metadata crawlers by paged query, and supports filtering by workspace, data source, type, environment, owner, and name.

ListCustomAgents.title: ListCustomAgents
ListCustomAgents.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of custom agents.

ListCustomAttributes.title: List custom attributes
ListCustomAttributes.summary: Queries the list of custom attribute definitions.

ListDIAlarmRules.title: ListDIAlarmRules
ListDIAlarmRules.summary: Views alert rules configured for a synchronization task.

ListDIJobEvents.title: ListDIJobEvents
ListDIJobEvents.summary: Queries events for a synchronization task.

ListDIJobMetrics.title: ListDIJobMetrics
ListDIJobMetrics.summary: Queries metrics for a synchronization task.

ListDIJobRunDetails.title: ListDIJobRunDetails
ListDIJobRunDetails.summary: Queries the running information about a synchronization task.

ListDataAssets.title: Query data assets associated with tags
ListDataAssets.summary: Queries DataWorks data assets that are associated with tags by paging.

ListDataQualityAlertRules.title: ListDataQualityAlertRules
ListDataQualityAlertRules.summary: Queries the list of data quality alert rules in a project.

ListDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstances.title: Queries the list of quality monitoring task instances
ListDataQualityEvaluationTaskInstances.summary: Performs a paginated query of the quality monitoring task instance list.

ListDataQualityEvaluationTasks.title: List quality watchtasks
ListDataQualityEvaluationTasks.summary: Queries a paged list of quality monitoring nodes by using paging.

ListDataQualityResults.title: Query data quality results
ListDataQualityResults.summary: Queries a list of data quality results by using paging.

ListDataQualityRuleTemplates.title: List data quality rule templates
ListDataQualityRuleTemplates.summary: Queries a list of data quality rule templates.

ListDataQualityRules.title: List quality rules
ListDataQualityRules.summary: Queries quality monitoring rules by paging.

ListDataQualityScanRuns.title: ListDataQualityScanRuns
ListDataQualityScanRuns.summary: Queries the run history of data quality scans in a specified project.

ListDataQualityScans.title: ListDataQualityScans
ListDataQualityScans.summary: Queries the list of data quality scan tasks in a project.

ListDataQualityTemplates.title: List data quality rule templates
ListDataQualityTemplates.summary: Queries the list of data quality rule templates in a specified project.

ListDataSourceSharedRules.title: ListDataSourceSharedRules
ListDataSourceSharedRules.summary: Retrieves a list of sharing rules for a data source.

ListDataSources.title: ListDataSources
ListDataSources.summary: Retrieves a list of data sources that match the specified filter conditions.

ListDatabases.title: ListDatabases
ListDatabases.summary: Queries a list of databases in an instance, cluster, or data catalog in Data Map. For DLF or StarRocks data sources, you can call this API operation to query databases in a data catalog. For StarRocks data sources, you can call this API operation to query databases in internal catalogs. For other types of data sources, you can call this API operation to query databases in an instance or cluster.

ListDatasetVersions.title: ListDatasetVersions
ListDatasetVersions.summary: Retrieves the version list for a given dataset.

ListDatasets.title: ListDatasets
ListDatasets.summary: Queries a list of datasets. Currently, DataWorks datasets and PAI datasets are supported.

ListDeploymentPackageFiles.title: Get file versions pending deployment
ListDeploymentPackageFiles.summary: Retrieves the list of file versions pending deployment.

ListDeploymentPackages.title: Query deployment packages
ListDeploymentPackages.summary: Queries a list of deployment packages.

ListDownstreamTaskInstances.title: List downstream instances
ListDownstreamTaskInstances.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of downstream instances for a specified instance.

ListDownstreamTasks.title: ListDownstreamTasks
ListDownstreamTasks.summary: Queries a list of descendant tasks of a task by page.

ListEntitiesInMetaCollection.title: ListEntitiesInMetaCollection
ListEntitiesInMetaCollection.summary: Queries a list of entities in a collection in Data Map. Collections include categories and data albums. Entities can only be tables.

ListFileVersions.title: Query file versions
ListFileVersions.summary: Queries the version list of a file.

ListFiles.title: Query file list
ListFiles.summary: Queries a list of files by calling ListFiles.

ListFunctions.title: List data development functions
ListFunctions.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of UDF functions in DataStudio. You can also use filter conditions to filter UDF functions.

ListImageAssociatedProjects.title: ListImageAssociatedProjects
ListImageAssociatedProjects.summary: Lists the workspaces associated with an image.

ListImageVersions.title: ListImageVersions
ListImageVersions.summary: Gets the details of a specified image version.

ListLineageRelationships.title: Query data lineage relationship list in data map
ListLineageRelationships.summary: Queries the list of data lineage relationships between two specified entities (tables, fields, OSS files, etc.) in DataWorks Data Map.

ListLineages.title: Query data lineage list of a data map entity
ListLineages.summary: Queries the upstream and downstream lineage entities for a specified entity in DataWorks Data Map, with an option to include detailed lineage relationship information.

ListMcpServers.title: ListMcpServers
ListMcpServers.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of MCP servers.

ListMetaCollections.title: Query data map collection list
ListMetaCollections.summary: Queries the list of Data Map collections. Supports querying both Data Map categories and data albums.

ListMetaEntities.title: Query metadata entity list
ListMetaEntities.summary: Queries a list of metadata entities. Currently, only custom entity types are supported.

ListMetaEntityDefs.title: Query metadata entity definition list
ListMetaEntityDefs.summary: Queries the list of custom entity definitions, including custom entity types and extension table types.

ListMyApplications.title: Query Permission Application Orders Initiated by Me
ListMyApplications.summary: Queries all resource access permission application orders initiated by the current user.

ListMyRelatedApprovals.title: Query permission application orders related to me
ListMyRelatedApprovals.summary: Query all permission application orders where the current user is an approver or stakeholder.

ListNetworks.title: ListNetworks
ListNetworks.summary: Retrieves a list of network resources for a serverless resource group.

ListNodeDependencies.title: ListNodeDependencies
ListNodeDependencies.summary: Gets a paginated list of dependent nodes for a specified data development node.

ListNodes.title: List data development nodes
ListNodes.summary: Retrieves a list of data development nodes with paging, and supports filtered query by specified conditions.

ListPartitions.title: Query partitions of a data map table
ListPartitions.summary: Queries the partition list of a specified table in DataWorks Data Map. Currently supports MaxCompute and HMS (EMR cluster) types.

ListPendingApprovals.title: Query Pending Permission Request Orders
ListPendingApprovals.summary: Retrieves the list of pending permission request orders for which the current user is the approver.

ListPipelineRunItems.title: ListPipelineRunItems
ListPipelineRunItems.summary: Queries the information about deployment objects by deployment process ID.

ListPipelineRuns.title: ListPipelineRuns
ListPipelineRuns.summary: Retrieve a paginated list of deployment processes. You can also filter this list based on specific criteria.

ListProcessDefinitions.title: ListProcessDefinitions
ListProcessDefinitions.summary: Queries process definitions of a specified type.

ListProjectMembers.title: ListProjectMembers
ListProjectMembers.summary: Gets a paginated list of workspace member details.

ListProjectRoles.title: ListProjectRoles
ListProjectRoles.summary: Returns a paginated list of roles in a workspace.

ListProjects.title: ListProjects
ListProjects.summary: Queries a list of DataWorks workspaces of the tenant to which your account belongs.

ListResourceGroupAssociateProjects.title: ListResourceGroupAssociateProjects
ListResourceGroupAssociateProjects.summary: Query the list of workspaces with which a resource group is associated

ListResourceGroupMetricData.title: ListResourceGroupMetricData
ListResourceGroupMetricData.summary: Queries the metric data of a resource group.

ListResourceGroups.title: ListResourceGroups
ListResourceGroups.summary: Retrieves a list of resource groups.

ListResources.title: List data development file resources
ListResources.summary: Queries resource files with pagination and filtering support.

ListRoutes.title: Get route list of a network resource
ListRoutes.summary: Retrieves the route list of a network resource.

ListSchemas.title: Query the list of database schemas in Data Map
ListSchemas.summary: Queries the list of schemas under a specified database or MaxCompute project in Data Map. Currently supports MaxCompute and Holo types.

ListSecurityStrategies.title: ListSecurityStrategies
ListSecurityStrategies.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of security policies based on specified conditions. This operation requires DataWorks tenant administrator or security administrator permissions.

ListSemanticJobRuns.title: Query semantic job run records
ListSemanticJobRuns.summary: Queries the run records of a created node by Name with paging. The JobRunId in each record is active for retrieving the results of a specific run, and the ExecutorJobId is active for querying details, retrieving logs, or stopping the run.

ListSemanticJobs.title: List semantic jobs
ListSemanticJobs.summary: Queries the semantic node definitions of the current tenant with paging. The Name, ProjectId, and Source fields in the list items can be used for running/deleting nodes, querying run details, and verifying input scope, respectively.

ListSkills.title: ListSkills
ListSkills.summary: Lists the Skills in your account.

ListSnapshots.title: Retrieve version snapshot list
ListSnapshots.summary: Retrieves a list of version snapshots.

ListTables.title: Query data tables in data map
ListTables.summary: Queries the list of data tables in DataWorks Data Map. For types that do not support the schema level, you can query data tables under a specified database. For types that support the schema level, you can query data tables under a specified database, MaxCompute project, or schema. The response contains only basic table information and does not include technical metadata or business metadata.

ListTaskInstanceOperationLogs.title: ListTaskInstanceOperationLogs
ListTaskInstanceOperationLogs.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of operation logs for a task instance.

ListTaskInstances.title: ListTaskInstances
ListTaskInstances.summary: Queries a list of instances. You can also specify filter conditions to query specific instances.

ListTaskOperationLogs.title: ListTaskOperationLogs
ListTaskOperationLogs.summary: Retrieves a paginated list of operation logs for a task.

ListTasks.title: ListTasks
ListTasks.summary: Queries a list of tasks by page. You can also specify filter conditions to query tasks.

ListUpstreamTaskInstances.title: List upstream instances
ListUpstreamTaskInstances.summary: Retrieves the upstream instances of a specified instance by page.

ListUpstreamTasks.title: ListUpstreamTasks
ListUpstreamTasks.summary: Queries a list of ancestor tasks of a task by page.

ListWorkflowDefinitions.title: ListWorkflowDefinitions
ListWorkflowDefinitions.summary: Queries a list of workflows in DataStudio. You can also specify filter conditions to query specific workflows.

ListWorkflowInstances.title: List workflow instances
ListWorkflowInstances.summary: Retrieves a paging list of workflow instances, with optional filtered query by conditions.

ListWorkflows.title: ListWorkflows
ListWorkflows.summary: Queries a list of workflows by page. You can also specify filter conditions to query workflows.

LoadAgentSession.title: LoadAgentSession
LoadAgentSession.summary: Loads the message history of an existing session and returns it as an SSE stream. If the session does not exist, the server sends a JSONRPCResponse.error with a code of 400 through the SSE stream. The Content-Type is text/event-stream. Use this operation to restore session context.

MoveFunction.title: MoveFunction
MoveFunction.summary: Moves a user-defined function (UDF) to a path in DataStudio.

MoveNode.title: MoveNode
MoveNode.summary: Moves a node to a path in DataStudio.

MoveResource.title: MoveResource
MoveResource.summary: Moves a file resource to a path in DataStudio.

MoveWorkflowDefinition.title: MoveWorkflowDefinition
MoveWorkflowDefinition.summary: Moves a workflow to a path in DataStudio.

PreviewDatasetVersion.title: PreviewDatasetVersion
PreviewDatasetVersion.summary: Previews the content of a specified dataset version. Currently only text file preview is supported for OSS-type datasets. Supported MIME types 1. application/json 2. application/xml 3. text/html 4. text/plain 5. application/octet-stream

PromptAgentSession.title: Send session prompt
PromptAgentSession.summary: Sends a user prompt to an existing session and returns the Agent response in streaming mode.

RemoveEntityFromMetaCollection.title: Remove an entity object from a Data Map collection
RemoveEntityFromMetaCollection.summary:
Remove an entity object from a Data Map collection. The collection supports Data Map categories and data albums, and the entity currently supports only the Data Table type.
When removing an entity from a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission or be the creator or administrator of the album.

RemoveTaskInstanceDependencies.title: RemoveTaskInstanceDependencies
RemoveTaskInstanceDependencies.summary: Removes multiple upstream dependencies of an instance at a time.

RenameFunction.title: RenameFunction
RenameFunction.summary: Renames a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio.

RenameResource.title: RenameResource
RenameResource.summary: Renames a file resource in DataStudio.

RerunTaskInstances.title: Rerun node instances
RerunTaskInstances.summary: Reruns multiple node instances in a batch.

ResumeTaskInstances.title: ResumeTaskInstances
ResumeTaskInstances.summary: Resumes multiple suspended instances at a time.

RevokeMemberProjectRoles.title: Revoke workspace roles from a workspace member
RevokeMemberProjectRoles.summary: Revokes roles from a workspace member.

RunCrawler.title: Run a metadata crawler
RunCrawler.summary: Triggers a specified metadata crawler to run and returns the submit status and associated task instance information.

RunSemanticJob.title: Run a semantic job
RunSemanticJob.summary: Submits a saved semantic job for execution by name and returns the run identifier and executor job identifier. A successful call indicates that the job has been submitted, not that the semantic model results have been generated.

SetSuccessTaskInstances.title: SetSuccessTaskInstances
SetSuccessTaskInstances.summary: Sets the statuses of multiple instances to successful at a time.

StartWorkflowInstances.title: Start workflow instances
StartWorkflowInstances.summary: Starts multiple workflow instances in a batch.

StopCrawler.title: Stop a metadata crawler run
StopCrawler.summary: Stops the currently running task of a specified metadata crawler.

StopProcessInstance.title: StopProcessInstance
StopProcessInstance.summary: Withdraws or terminates a specified process instance.

StopTaskInstances.title: Stop instances
StopTaskInstances.summary: Stops multiple instances in a batch.

StopWorkflowInstances.title: StopWorkflowInstances
StopWorkflowInstances.summary: Stops multiple workflow instances at a time.

SubmitFile.title: SubmitFile
SubmitFile.summary: Commits a file to the development environment of the scheduling system to generate a task.

SuspendTaskInstances.title: SuspendTaskInstances
SuspendTaskInstances.summary: Suspends multiple instances at a time.

TestDataSourceConnectivity.title: Test the connectivity of a data source
TestDataSourceConnectivity.summary: Test the connectivity of a data source on a resource group.

TriggerSchedulerTaskInstance.title: TriggerSchedulerTaskInstance
TriggerSchedulerTaskInstance.summary: Triggers a task to run by using an HTTP Trigger node at a specified time.

UpdateAlertRule.title: UpdateAlertRule
UpdateAlertRule.summary: Updates the information about a custom alert monitoring rule.

UpdateColumnBusinessMetadata.title: UpdateColumnBusinessMetadata
UpdateColumnBusinessMetadata.summary: Updates the business metadata for a column in a data map. This operation can only update the business description and custom attributes.

UpdateComputeResource.title: UpdateComputeResource
UpdateComputeResource.summary: Modifies the specified computing resource based on the computing resource ID.

UpdateCrawler.title: Update a metadata crawler
UpdateCrawler.summary: Updates the resource group, collection scope, scheduling, and extension configurations of a specified metadata crawler.

UpdateDIAlarmRule.title: UpdateDIAlarmRule
UpdateDIAlarmRule.summary: Updates an alert rule configured for a synchronization task.

UpdateDataQualityAlertRule.title: Update a data quality alert rule
UpdateDataQualityAlertRule.summary: Updates a specified data quality monitoring alert rule.

UpdateDataQualityEvaluationTask.title: Update data quality monitoring
UpdateDataQualityEvaluationTask.summary: Updates a data quality validation task.

UpdateDataQualityRuleTemplate.title: Updates a data quality rule template
UpdateDataQualityRuleTemplate.summary: Updates a data quality rule template.

UpdateDataQualityTemplate.title: UpdateDataQualityTemplate
UpdateDataQualityTemplate.summary: Updates a data quality rule template in a project

UpdateDataSource.title: UpdateDataSource
UpdateDataSource.summary: Modifies a data source by ID.

UpdateDataset.title: UpdateDataset
UpdateDataset.summary: Updates dataset information. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. The operator must be the creator of the dataset or the administrator of the workspace where the dataset is located.

UpdateDatasetVersion.title: UpdateDatasetVersion
UpdateDatasetVersion.summary: Updates dataset version information. Only DataWorks datasets are supported. Requires dataset creator or workspace administrator permissions.

UpdateFolder.title: UpdateFolder
UpdateFolder.summary: Invoke UpdateFolder to update the folder information.

UpdateFunction.title: UpdateFunction
UpdateFunction.summary: Updates the basic information about a user-defined function (UDF) in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec.

UpdateIDEEventResult.title: UpdateIDEEventResult
UpdateIDEEventResult.summary: Recalls the check result of the message of an extension point event.

UpdateMetaCollection.title: Update Data Map Collection Object
UpdateMetaCollection.summary:
Update Data Map collection objects, including Data Map categories and data albums. You can update the collection name, description, and administrator information.
When updating a data album, the caller must have the AliyunDataWorksFullAccess permission or be the creator or an administrator of the album.

UpdateMetaEntity.title: UpdateMetaEntity
UpdateMetaEntity.summary: Updates a metadata entity. You can update custom entities or objects of the extended table type, such as databases, tables, and columns.

UpdateMetaEntityDef.title: Update metadata entity definition
UpdateMetaEntityDef.summary: Updates a metadata entity definition, including custom entity types and extension table types.

UpdateNode.title: UpdateNode
UpdateNode.summary: Updates the basic information about a node in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec.

UpdateParameter.title: UpdateParameter
UpdateParameter.summary: Updates a parameter. This operation performs an incremental update and modifies only the specified fields.

UpdateProcessDefinition.title: UpdateProcessDefinition
UpdateProcessDefinition.summary: Updates an existing approval process definition.

UpdateProject.title: UpdateProject
UpdateProject.summary: This operation updates a DataWorks workspace.

UpdateProjectRole.title: Update a workspace custom role
UpdateProjectRole.summary: Updates the permissions of a custom role in a workspace.

UpdateResource.title: UpdateResource
UpdateResource.summary: Updates the basic information about a file resource in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec.

UpdateResourceGroup.title: UpdateResourceGroup
UpdateResourceGroup.summary: Updates basic information about a resource group.

UpdateRoute.title: UpdateRoute
UpdateRoute.summary: Updates the information about a route.

UpdateSecurityStrategy.title: UpdateSecurityStrategy
UpdateSecurityStrategy.summary: To modify the configuration of an existing security policy, you must be both a DataWorks tenant administrator and a security administrator.

UpdateSkill.title: Update a skill
UpdateSkill.summary: Updates a specified Skill and generates a new version.

UpdateTableBusinessMetadata.title: Update business metadata of a data map table
UpdateTableBusinessMetadata.summary: Updates the business metadata of a table in Data Map. Currently, only the table usage description and custom attributes can be updated.

UpdateTask.title: Update a node
UpdateTask.summary: Updates a specified node. The modifications are synchronized to DataStudio, where a new saved version is created.

UpdateTaskInstances.title: Modify Task Instance Properties
UpdateTaskInstances.summary: Modify the properties of multiple task instances in batch, including priority, resource group, data source, and more.

UpdateUdfFile.title: UpdateUdfFile
UpdateUdfFile.summary: Updates the file information about a function.

UpdateWorkflow.title: Update a workflow
UpdateWorkflow.summary: Updates a specified workflow by using the full update method. Fields that can be synchronously updated to DataStudio include: owner, data source, schedule resource group, description, and trigger run mode (Normal, Skip, or Pause).

UpdateWorkflowDefinition.title: UpdateWorkflowDefinition
UpdateWorkflowDefinition.summary: Updates the basic information about a workflow in DataStudio. This API operation performs an incremental update. The update information is described by using FlowSpec.

UploadSemanticFile.title: Request an upload URL for semantic task attachments
UploadSemanticFile.summary: Requests a temporary OSS PUT upload URL. Complete the PUT upload before the URL expires, then pass the returned FileId to the ReferenceFileIds parameter of CreateSemanticJob.
